Rohit S: Heads up — during a config audit I found several Vault transit keys with `allow_decrypt=true` and broad GCP KMS IAM bindings. That means some secrets were stored unwrapped in kv and rely on transit but comparators show plaintext copies. Need emergency lock-down and rewrap plan. @Maya can you validate which secrets are affected?
Maya L: On it. Running `vault list -format=json secret/ | xargs -I{} vault kv get -format=json secret/{}` then grepping for known markers. Found ~12 secrets under `secret/projects/*/legacy/` with `service_account_json` fields that look unwrapped.
Akshay: Copy. Immediate triage: 1) apply temporary Vault policy to deny writes to transit keys and restrict decrypt, 2) snapshot current state and audit logs, 3) rotate/deprecate affected transit keys and rewrap plaintext entries using a new, properly-bounded KMS key. I'll start the policy push.
Jamie P: Platform note: We should also push a KMS IAM change to remove the overly-broad member `serviceAccount:raw-ingest@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com` from the CryptoKey IAM binding. Add a deny rule where possible.
sre-bot: Created incident `vault-transit-misconfig-3945678901` and webhook to #incidents. Pager scheduled.
Maya L: Snapshot created at s3://redwood-incidents/3945678901/vault-snapshot-2026-05-10.tar.gz. I listed affected paths: `secret/projects/edge/legacy/service_creds`, `secret/projects/core/legacy/db_creds`, `secret/projects/partnerA/legacy/sa_json`, etc.
Akshay: Pushing temp Vault policy now: `vault policy write deny-transit-limit - <<EOF
path "transit/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
  allowed_parameters = {"decrypt" = []}
}
EOF` — this restricts decrypt access from non-admin principals. Also applying `vault write sys/policies/acl/deny-transit limit=...` (implementation details).
Rohit S: Confirmed policy applied. Now let's rotate the KMS keys backing our transit key. Steps: create new KMS key with constrained IAM, rekey Vault transit: `vault write -f transit/keys/new-key` then `vault write transit/rewrap -old=transit/keys/old-key -new=transit/keys/new-key`? (rough idea, follow runbook).
Jamie P: I'll lock down GCP KMS IAM: remove all `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from broad groups and only grant to `serviceAccount:vault-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `platform-audit@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also enable KMS audit logs export.
Maya L: While rotating, I'm marking the affected KV entries as compromised. We'll write new keys to `secret/projects/*/legacy/service_creds.v2` with KMS-envelope encryption and update consumers.
Akshay: Running rewrap job that reads plaintext values, encrypts with new transit key and writes to `.v2` paths. Command sketch: `for p in $(list); do v=$(vault kv get -field=value $p); echo $v | vault write transit/encrypt/new-key plaintext=- | jq -r .ciphertext > ${p}.v2; done` — we'll run in staging then prod.
Rohit S: Important: add vault audit log shipping to SIEM before we re-enable full decrypts. `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit_transit.log` and ship to central.
sre-bot: Audit shipping job created and running.
Jamie P: Also add RBAC change to deny any service accounts from binding keys to external partners. I'll open an org-policy PR to forbid external members on KMS CryptoKey IAM.
Maya L: Consumers list: edge-workers, core-api, partner-ingest. I'm creating a CI job to swap env vars to `.v2` secrets and restart pods. Will coordinate with SRE for rolling restart windows.
Akshay: After rewrap and consumer update, we'll revoke old transit key and set TTLs on replaced secrets. Also schedule a 72h monitor for any decrypt errors and anomalous KMS activity.
Rohit S: Legal/Audit asked for timeline. Akshay, can you post the exact commands you ran and timestamps so audit team can link actions?
Akshay: Will post a concise runbook in the incident doc with timestamps. Started policy push at 2026-05-10T09:21:00Z; rewrap job kicked at 2026-05-10T09:45:00Z.
Maya L: Rewrap completed for 9/12 secrets in staging; prod queue running. No evidence of external decrypts in KMS logs prior to policy lock, but audit export continues.
Jamie P: Post-incident action items: 1) enforce KMS key binding whitelist 2) add pre-commit Vault linter to flag storing raw private keys 3) migrate legacy KV paths to require envelope encryption 4) RBAC review quarterly. I'll own tickets 1 & 2.
Rohit S: Thanks everyone. Legal/Audit looped. Leaving thread open for any unexpected decrypt attempts or consumer breakage. :lock:
